SEARCH
程序包 org.bukkit.structure

接口 Structure

所有超级接口:
PersistentDataHolder, PersistentDataViewHolder
public interface Structure extends PersistentDataHolder
表示一个结构。

结构是一个可变的模板，包含已捕获的方块和实体，可以复制回世界中。 通过 Server.getStructureManager() 获取的 StructureManager 允许你创建新结构、加载现有结构和保存结构。

为了使结构能被结构方块使用，需要在 StructureManager 中 注册， 或者位于主世界文件夹、数据包或服务器自身的默认资源中，以便 StructureManager 能找到它。

原文： Represents a structure.

A structure is a mutable template of captured blocks and entities that can be copied back into the world. The StructureManager, retrieved via Server.getStructureManager(), allows you to create new structures, load existing structures, and save structures.

In order for a structure to be usable by structure blocks, it needs to be null registered with the StructureManager, or located in the primary world folder, a DataPack, or the server's own default resources, so that the StructureManager can find it.

    • place

      void place(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, boolean includeEntities, @NotNull @NotNull StructureRotation structureRotation, @NotNull @NotNull Mirror mirror, int palette, float integrity, @NotNull @NotNull java.util.Random random)
      将结构放置到世界中。

      原文： Place a structure in the world.

      参数:
      location - 放置结构的位置。

      原文：The location to place the structure at.

      includeEntities - 是否生成结构中存在的实体。

      原文：If the entities present in the structure should be spawned.

      structureRotation - 结构的旋转。

      原文：The rotation of the structure.

      mirror - 结构的镜像设置。

      原文：The mirror settings of the structure.

      palette - 要使用的结构调色板索引，从 0 开始，或使用 -1 随机选择调色板。

      原文：The palette index of the structure to use, starting at 0, or -1 to pick a random palette.

      integrity - 通过随机跳过放置方块来决定建筑的损坏程度。此值范围为 0 到 1。 0 表示移除所有方块，1 表示以原始状态生成结构。

      原文：Determines how damaged the building should look by randomly skipping blocks to place. This value can range from 0 to 1. With 0 removing all blocks and 1 spawning the structure in pristine condition.

      random - 用于设置结构 LootTable 和完整性的随机数生成器。

      原文：The randomizer used for setting the structure's LootTables and integrity.

    • fill

      void fill(@NotNull @NotNull Location corner1, @NotNull @NotNull Location corner2, boolean includeEntities)
      从世界中的一个区域填充结构。原点和尺寸将根据提供的两个角自动计算。

      原文： Fills the structure from an area in a world. The origin and size will be calculated automatically from the two corners provided.

      Be careful as this will override the current data of the structure.

      Be aware that this method allows for creating structures larger than the 48x48x48 size that Minecraft's Structure blocks support. Any structures saved this way can not be loaded by using a structure block. Using the API however will still work.

      参数:
      corner1 - 结构的一个角。

      原文：A corner of the structure.

      corner2 - 与 corner1 相对的角。

      原文：The corner opposite from corner1.

      includeEntities - 是否在保存的结构中包含实体。

      原文：true if entities should be included in the saved structure.

    • fill

      void fill(@NotNull @NotNull Location origin, @NotNull @NotNull BlockVector size, boolean includeEntities)
      从世界中的一个区域填充结构，从指定的原点开始，沿各轴按指定的尺寸向量扩展。

      原文： Fills the Structure from an area in a world, starting at the specified origin and extending in each axis according to the specified size vector.

      Be careful as this will override the current data of the structure.

      Be aware that this method allows for saving structures larger than the 48x48x48 size that Minecraft's Structure blocks support. Any structures saved this way can not be loaded by using a structure block. Using the API however will still work.

      参数:
      origin - 结构的原点。

      原文：The origin of the structure.

      size - 结构的尺寸，必须至少为 1x1x1。

      原文：The size of the structure, must be at least 1x1x1.

      includeEntities - 是否在保存的结构中包含实体。

      原文：true if entities should be included in the saved structure.

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果尺寸小于 1x1x1 则抛出异常。

      原文：Thrown if size is smaller than 1x1x1
